scope: Development prototype from three already-selected checkpoints. No new policy success, placement, real-time, held-out or novelty claim.
orientation_family: Vertical and +/-20-degree rolls/pitches; translation along negative hand z for approach/lift; constant orientation during transport.
uncertainty_scope: Fixed design sensitivity bounds on fixture pose, not calibrated confidence intervals. Does not bound capsule fit errors or cover arbitrary scene geometry.
sampling_limits: Sampled path with 2 mm local-box inflation, not certified continuous collision detection or calibrated tracking uncertainty.
physical_evaluation: One preselected top-ranked kinematically feasible action per mode/state, or explicit abstention; recorded v5 target is the common assay reference. Physical outcomes never feed action selection. Preserve collision and missed-grasp outcomes. Retained lift is not placement.
not_integrated: No original controller changes. Frozen learned observations deliberately isolate mechanics; online reacquisition, arm/self collisions, unmodeled obstacles and placement retention remain unresolved. Abstention requests reacquisition/replanning; automatic pushing/repositioning is not implemented.
